payload.notes: E3 (RAG Engine) depends only on E2, which is done. Revised four times after human review of the first draft. Revision 1 added two things on top of the original five tickets: (a) E3-T01 now has an explicit cost-consciousness AC -- target Voyage AI's free tier, exact terms verified against Voyage's current docs at implementation time (same 'verify at ticket time' convention as ADR-6); (b) new E3-T06 (Per-Session Usage Guardrail) caps a session's cumulative embedding (T01) and LLM (T03/T04) calls, returning a distinguishable 'limit reached' result rather than a generic error, scoped per-session -- this resolves sprint 1's deferred cross-sprint flag ('Rate limiting stays deferred ... revisit when the [LLM] key is live in E3 -- an unauthenticated PoC endpoint that spends money per request is the point where this stops being premature', sprint-1/design.md flag 8), it is that flag coming due, not a new concern. Revision 2 added one more E3-T06 AC: the guardrail must expose remaining usage as a percentage/fraction of the cap (not just an allowed/blocked boolean), queryable at any point in the session, so a later UI (E4/E7) can display 'remaining trial usage' -- data only, no display/formatting in this epic. Revision 3 added a cost-conscious model-tier AC to E3-T03: the LLM call uses the cheapest available Claude tier (Haiku), not a higher tier (CLAUDE.md 'Decisions Already Made'), exact current Haiku model id verified against Anthropic's docs at implementation time (same verify-at-ticket-time convention); E3-T04 cross-references this (same Haiku call, streamed -- no separate model decision needed there). Revision 4 adjusted that same E3-T03 AC: the model id must be configurable via an env var (ADR-3's typed env-config module pattern) rather than hard-coded, defaulting to the Haiku tier when unset -- unlike ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/VOYAGE_API_KEY (required secrets that fail startup if missing), an unset model id falls back to its default rather than failing startup; only a malformed *provided* value should fail fast. Exact env var name, default value string, and current Haiku model id are all left for the Architect/Coder to verify against Anthropic's docs at ticket time -- not prescribed here, same treatment as the guardrail's cap mechanism/numeric limit and embedding-model-variant/context-window-management elsewhere in this plan. Sequencing/dependency shape is otherwise unchanged: T01/T02 producer pair -> T03 consumer -> T04/T05 extend T03 -> T06 closes the loop across all paid-API call sites established by T01/T03/T04/T05. LLM provider is Claude via @langchain/anthropic (Haiku tier, env-configurable) and embeddings are Voyage AI (CLAUDE.md decision, ADR-6 amendment) -- no OpenAI anywhere in this epic. Per ADR-8, the LLM and embedding clients must be injectable collaborators (no module-level mocking available), which the Architect should carry into design.md. No HTTP endpoints are wired yet (E4's scope); all E2E flows are framed from the developer/integrator or end-user conversational perspective, consistent with E1/E2's ticket framing.
